resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Indonesian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Indonesian pass identified 25 actionable defects in battery summaries, evidence notes, and safety wording; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Indonesian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary omitted the battery context.
evidence: The previous wording described a removable rechargeable cell but did not identify it as a battery cell.
findings.resolution: Clarified that the item is a removable rechargeable battery cell.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary used less natural wording for an internal pack.
evidence: The previous text described a pack installed inside the device rather than an internal battery pack.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as an internal battery pack and retained the user-replaceable-cell distinction.

findings.summary: The approval note omitted the approval date.
evidence: The previous text only said to see the associated research note.
findings.resolution: Restored the approval date 2026-08-13 and the research-note reference.

findings.summary: The capacity note used less direct wording for the labeled value.
evidence: The previous sentence referred generally to what is listed rather than the capacity shown on the label.
findings.resolution: Clarified that true capacity is lower than the capacity shown on the label.

findings.summary: The continuous-rating note used imprecise ‘value’ terminology.
evidence: The previous text translated rating as a generic continuous value.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a 20 A continuous rating and retained the exclusion of pulse ratings.

findings.summary: The wrapper and production-revision note used awkward wrapper terminology.
evidence: The previous text used a literal term for wrapper and did not clearly describe the exact wrapper.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it around the exact wrapper and retained the independent 20 A comparison.

findings.summary: The exact-model note used awkward model wording.
evidence: The previous text described the exact model with an unnatural literal expression.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 15 A value from exact-model testing.

findings.summary: The tabless-revision note used an awkward substitution warning.
evidence: The previous wording said not to replace the value with pulse values in a less natural construction.
findings.resolution: Clarified the independent 45 A continuous value for the tested tabless revision.

findings.summary: The 36 A continuous value used a less precise temperature caveat.
evidence: The previous sentence omitted the natural ‘dibatasi oleh suhu’ construction.
findings.resolution: Clarified the real 36 A continuous value and temperature-limited 56 A figure.

findings.summary: The pre-production wording was less natural.
evidence: The previous text used a compressed form for pre-production cells.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as tested cells originating from pre-production and lacking the CCC logo.

findings.summary: The cycle-life limitation was awkwardly phrased.
evidence: The previous text used an unnatural expression for the intended cycle-life limit.
findings.resolution: Retained the recommended 13 A continuous value and clarified the absolute 16.8 A maximum.

findings.summary: The pre-production sample caveat used less natural grammar.
evidence: The previous text said the samples ‘were pre-production’ in an awkward construction.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as samples originating from pre-production and retained the 40 A and 70 A limits.

findings.summary: The production-cell comparison value used an unclear noun order.
evidence: The previous text combined the value and production-cell description as a compressed noun phrase.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 40 A comparison value from a production cell.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note omitted the degree symbol and used awkward wrapper wording.
evidence: The previous text displayed 60 C and used a literal term for exact wrapper.
findings.resolution: Restored 60 °C and clarified the 40 A exact-wrapper value and EVE 40PL rewrap.

findings.summary: The exact-tested-sample note used compressed wording.
evidence: The previous text did not clearly distinguish exact tested samples.
findings.resolution: Clarified the exact samples, their pre-production appearance, and missing CCC marks.

findings.summary: The 90 A temperature limitation used less natural grammar.
evidence: The previous text used a compressed form for a temperature-limited rating.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 90 A limited by temperature and retained the pre-production caveat.

findings.summary: The unresolved production-continuity caveat was awkwardly phrased.
evidence: The previous text used a literal expression for production continuity remaining unresolved.
findings.resolution: Clarified the temperature-limited 60 A value and unresolved production continuity.

findings.summary: The inconsistent-capacity wording was less natural.
evidence: The previous text used ‘tidak konsisten’ where ‘tidak seragam’ is clearer in this evidence note.
findings.resolution: Changed the capacity caveat to the clearer Indonesian wording and retained CCC/CE marks.

findings.summary: The exact-tested-sample note used compressed wording.
evidence: The previous text did not clearly distinguish exact tested samples from other samples.
findings.resolution: Clarified the exact samples, their pre-production appearance, and missing CCC marks.

findings.summary: The tester-estimated value used awkward noun order.
evidence: The previous phrase placed the tester estimate after the value in an unnatural construction.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 30 A continuous value according to the tester's estimate.

findings.summary: The two-batch production note used a compressed phrase for the tested batches.
evidence: The previous wording did not clearly connect the batches with their production relationship.
findings.resolution: Clarified that the 20 A value comes from two tested production-related batches.

findings.summary: The continuous-versus-pulse distinction used a fragmentary opening.
evidence: The previous text began with ‘Kontinu 12 A’ rather than a natural Indonesian sentence fragment.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘12 A kontinu; 20 A hanya untuk pulsa’ and preserved the exact wrapper identifier.

findings.summary: The wrapper and sourcing caveat used awkward technical wording.
evidence: The previous text used compressed wording for exact wrapper, rewrap sourcing, and later revisions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the exact 20 A value, tester recommendation, advertisement, and sourcing caveat.

findings.summary: The exact-model rewrap note used awkward sourcing terminology.
evidence: The previous text referred to rewrap and subsequent wrapper revisions with compressed wording.
findings.resolution: Clarified the 30 A exact-model value, rewrap status, and possible sourcing differences.

findings.summary: The revision-specific inheritance warning used awkward wording.
evidence: The previous text did not clearly state that four-leg and later revisions are materially different.
findings.resolution: Clarified the exact five-leg revision value and warned against inheriting this profile.
